value.rationale: The right-corner simplex is a canonical element for orthogonal-grid finite-element meshes. Sharp linear equivalence of minimum solid angle and diameter-normalized volume, beyond the general quadratic converse, identifies precisely which shape restriction prevents sliver-type degradation. Full all-dimensional constant optimization, exact equality and nonattainment, two distinct limiting geometries, and dimension asymptotics provide natural structural insight and quantitative benchmarks, not an arbitrary computational slice.
